item.title: Version 1.6.5
item.changes: Redesigned sliders throughout the app, with a slim track and a narrow knob that turns to glass while you drag A refreshed Color Picker that's more compact, with a new and current color comparison UI polish across panels and tool bars Fixed stroke layer effects being uneven or clipped on rounded shapes Fixed painting past the edges of a scaled-down layer, which could fail with a GPU error
